newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: MMB TO OPEN BRATISLAVA MONEY BROKERAGE IN MID-DEC.
newsitem.headline: MMB TO OPEN BRATISLAVA MONEY BROKERAGE IN MID-DEC.

text.p: Money Market Brokers (MMB) on Wednesday said it will open a money market broking operation in Bratislava in mid-December, the first institution of its kind in Slovakia.

MMB Bratislava Managing Director Dalibor Cernicka told Reuters he hoped to attract the business of up to one-third of the local money market which has an estimated daily turnover at some seven to 10 billion crowns.

"We intend to intermediate some 30 percent of the deals on the Slovak market, which could lead to an increase in it's liquidity and narrowing of spreads," Cernicka said while visiting the Czech headquarters of MMB in Prague.
Cernicka said MMB Bratislava would cover crown deposit transactions, and foreign exchange spot, swap, forward and FRA transactions.
For banks licenced in Slovakia the MMB would also intermediate deals with Finance Ministry T-bills and bonds, and central bank liquidity bills, he added.
